description: Replacement peg for a missing peg in a jigsaw item. A 5.8mm head stands 7.4mm proud with a chamfered top edge; a 3.6mm shank, 5.5mm long, slips into the 3.8mm x 6mm hole with 0.2mm diametral clearance.
printing_notes: Print as exported: head top face down, flat on the bed, shank pointing up. No supports needed.

The shank prints at 3.6mm (0.2mm diametral clearance) for a slip fit in the 3.8mm hole; glue it in with PVA or CA. If your hole runs tight or loose, adjust the clearance parameter in the customizer and re-render.
Keep seat_gap above zero so the head lands on the piece before the shank bottoms out in the 6mm hole.
PETG or PLA at 0.12-0.16mm layers with 100% infill; layer lines run across the shank, so glue it rather than relying on the print alone.
Re-measure the height of a surviving peg and set head_h to match.
